question: Who among the following is an Indian Paralympic swimmer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sharath M Gayakwad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sharath M Gayakwad **__is an Indian Paralympic swimmer.
 
• At the 2014 Asian Games, he broke P.T. Usha's record for the most number of medals by an Indian at any multi-discipline event by winning 6 medals.
 
• He is the first Indian swimmer to qualify for the Paralympics and competed in the 2012 Summer Paralympics in London.
 
• He has now retired and is the program director of Zee Swim Academy, a swimming club in Bangalore.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Sukant Indukant Kadam** is an Indian professional para-badminton player. He won Bronze medal at the BWF Para Badminton World Championships.
 
• In 2014, **Gaurav Khanna** was appointed chief national coach for para players and within a span of some 6 years, his students have won 319 medals internationally.
 
• **Pramod Bhagat** is an Indian professional Para-badminton player from Odisha. He won a gold medal at the 2020 Summer Paralympics in Men's singles SL3.
